description: Work with the page three_session started, without reloading it. op eval runs JS in the page and returns the value as compact JSON (vectors as [x,y,z], colours as hex, objects as type/name/position), with `scene`, `camera`, `renderer` (the last ones rendered), `$('name')` (getObjectByName), `$$('Type')` and `THREE` (when global) in scope; a single expression is returned, statements need `return`. op steps runs interactions (click, press, drag, wheel, wait, wait-for); op frames waits n animation frames; op until waits until a JS expression is true; op screenshot returns the picture; op inspect reads the scene graph and why objects are not visible; op look measures the frame as text (as three_look, with expect claims and annotate); op textures lists every texture with its slot, size, colour space and GPU memory, and the mistakes (a colour map read as linear, a data map read as sRGB, too big); op diff compares the scene with the last op diff (added, removed, moved, hidden, new material); op reload loads edited files (state starts over); op errors lists the errors so far. Every answer ends with the new console and page errors.

annotate.description: for look: also return the frame with numbered boxes and names

expect.description: for look: claims about the frame, as in three_look

js.description: for eval and until, e.g. $('player').position or scene.children.length

steps.description: Interactions before the screenshot: click (selector or x,y), press (key), drag, wheel, wait, wait-for.

name: three_page
title: Look at and drive the live page
